risk: Long gate runs could appear stalled because the parent runner only printed the next script name and child output could be block-buffered under file redirection. A timeout or slow step therefore left operators guessing which validator was active and whether it was making progress.
changes: scripts/gate.py now invokes child Python validators with -u and PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1 so child progress is visible when gate output is redirected to a log.
scripts/gate.py now prints runner START and OK records with per-step duration.
scripts/gate.py now supports optional per-step timeout via GATE_STEP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS without changing the default no-timeout semantics.
Timeout and non-zero exits now identify the failing script and elapsed time.
default_timeout_semantics: no per-step timeout unless GATE_STEP_TIMEOUT_SECONDS is set to a positive numeric value
